exposure: Prenatal, pregnancy, or postpartum-related environmental factors
outcome: Risk of multiple sclerosis (MS) in children
cohort: Children with MS or clinically isolated syndrome and healthy controls
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a reduced risk of pediatric-onset MS, while maternal illness during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a 60% reduction in the odds of having MS.
followup_time: Median age 15.7 years for cases, 14.6 years for controls
